decisionSummary: The Aug 19 dev-publish v22/2.0.29 source is canonical. It retains the full rich miniPaint release line, adds the tested scoped read-only GrainContext integration for Jinn, removes a stale offline release document, and validates candidate-bound catalog metadata. Main is its reviewed stable ancestor; the divergent metadata and historical publish/codex refs are old package or release lines and contain no newer runnable Paint source.
